## Data Visualization Assignment 2

```{r}
getwd()
library(here)
biodiversity <- read.csv(here("data", "BIO.csv"))
str(biodiversity)
summary(biodiversity)
```

### This semester I plan to conduct a project examining AI-human substitution beliefs and AI idealizing beliefs. I am interested in what factors predict these beliefs, and how they change over time. I will use longitudinal data to assess how T1 AI beliefs develop at T2, and how they might relate to peoples' experiences interacting with others.
